#palette
```{r palette}

# ggprism stores fill colours and outline colours separately
pal_fill   <- tryCatch(ggprism::ggprism_data$fill_palettes$floral,   error = function(e) NULL)
pal_border <- tryCatch(ggprism::ggprism_data$colour_palettes$floral, error = function(e) NULL)

# Fallback: six swatches read from the Prism screenshot
if (is.null(pal_fill) || is.null(pal_border)) {
  message("ggprism lookup failed; using screenshot values.")
  pal_fill   <- c("#95B0D9", "#B09FD7", "#E5AEEB", "#CBE1A0", "#5399B8", "#725FA0")
  pal_border <- c("#40659D", "#5E429B", "#963B9B", "#719C43", "#24506B", "#41375D")
}

# Fixed colour per phylum and per CAZyme class, so every figure matches
phylum_levels <- c("Bacteroidota", "Bacillota", "Pseudomonadota", "Actinomycetota",
                   "Verrucomicrobiota", "Campylobacterota", "Fusobacteriota")
class_levels  <- c("GH", "GT", "PL", "CE", "AA", "CBM")

stopifnot(length(pal_fill) >= length(phylum_levels))

phylum_fill   <- setNames(pal_fill[seq_along(phylum_levels)],   phylum_levels)
phylum_border <- setNames(pal_border[seq_along(phylum_levels)], phylum_levels)
class_fill    <- setNames(pal_fill[seq_along(class_levels)],    class_levels)
```



```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Single definition of the data path, used for both reading and output location
data_file <- base::path.expand(
  "~/HMS Dropbox/Daniela Coronado/Daniela's data/Cancer Immunotherapy/SnapGene constructs or 16S sequencing/Glycosyltransferases/cazy_data_20260910.txt"
)
out_dir <- base::dirname(data_file)
stopifnot(base::file.exists(data_file), base::dir.exists(out_dir))

cazy_raw <- read_tsv(
  data_file,
  col_names = c("Enzyme", "Domain", "Organism", "Accession", "Source"),
  quote = "", show_col_types = FALSE
)

dplyr::count(cazy_raw, Domain)

cazy_raw <- cazy_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Organism), Domain == "Bacteria")

# Parse each distinct organism once
org_lookup <- cazy_raw %>%
  distinct(Organism) %>%
  mutate(
    clean   = Organism %>% str_remove("^Candidatus\\s+") %>% str_remove_all("[\\[\\]]"),
    Genus   = word(clean, 1),
    Species = word(clean, 2),
    Strain  = coalesce(word(clean, 3, -1), ""),
    Genome  = paste(Genus, Species, Strain, sep = "|")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Organism, Genus, Species, Strain, Genome)

# Parse each distinct enzyme code once
enz_lookup <- cazy_raw %>%
  distinct(Enzyme) %>%
  mutate(
    # Collapse subfamilies to the basic family: GH13_5 -> GH13, CBM50(2) -> CBM50
    Family = str_extract(Enzyme, "^(GH|GT|PL|CE|AA|CBM)\\d+"),
    Class  = str_extract(Family, "^[A-Z]+")
  )

cazy_raw <- cazy_raw %>%
  left_join(org_lookup, by = "Organism") %>%
  left_join(enz_lookup, by = "Enzyme")

# Check what gets discarded (not a recognizable CAZy family code)
cazy_raw %>% filter(is.na(Family)) %>% dplyr::count(Enzyme, sort = TRUE) %>% print()

cazy <- cazy_raw %>% filter(!is.na(Family))

# Count of genes per genome per family
genome_fam_counts <- cazy %>% dplyr::count(Genus, Genome, Class, Family, name = "count")
```

#genus to phylum lookup
```{r phylum-map}
genera <- cazy_raw %>% filter(!is.na(Genus)) %>% distinct(Genus) %>% pull(Genus)

# 1. Every genus-rank NCBI match for each name (homonyms can return several)
ids <- name2taxid(genera, db = "ncbi", out_type = "summary") %>%
  mutate(rank = taxid2rank(id, db = "ncbi")) %>%
  filter(rank == "genus")

# 2. Full lineage for each matched taxid
ids_u <- unique(ids$id)
cls   <- classification(ids_u, db = "ncbi")
if (is.null(names(cls))) names(cls) <- ids_u
get_rank <- function(x, r) if (is.data.frame(x)) x$name[x$rank %in% r][1] else NA_character_

lineage <- tibble(
  id     = ids_u,
  Domain = vapply(cls[as.character(ids_u)], get_rank, character(1), r = c("domain", "superkingdom")),
  Phylum = vapply(cls[as.character(ids_u)], get_rank, character(1), r = "phylum")
)

# 3. Keep bacterial matches only (resolves names shared with plants/animals/fungi),
#    then one phylum per genus
genus_phylum <- ids %>%
  left_join(lineage, by = "id") %>%
  filter(Domain == "Bacteria", !is.na(Phylum)) %>%
  distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    Genus  = name,
    # renames old phylum names only; does not reassign any genus
    Phylum = recode(Phylum,
      "Bacteroidetes"   = "Bacteroidota",
      "Firmicutes"      = "Bacillota",
      "Proteobacteria"  = "Pseudomonadota",
      "Actinobacteria"  = "Actinomycetota",
      "Fusobacteria"    = "Fusobacteriota",
      "Verrucomicrobia" = "Verrucomicrobiota")
  )

# Report: what was and wasn't resolved
message(nrow(genus_phylum), " of ", length(genera), " genera assigned a phylum")
setdiff(genera, genus_phylum$Genus) %>% head(30) %>% print()   # unmatched names
dplyr::count(genus_phylum, Phylum, sort = TRUE) %>% print(n = 40)
```
#per-genome richness
```{r genome-richness}
genome_div <- genome_fam_counts %>%
  group_by(Genus, Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cazymes = sum(count),
    richness      = n_distinct(Family),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )
```


```{r human-gut-check}
# Run once in the console if needed: BiocManager::install("curatedMetagenomicData")
prevalence_min <- 0.01   # call a taxon "found" if it is detected in at least 1% of samples
set.seed(1)

# Healthy adult stool samples, one per person, 500 at random to keep the download manageable
meta <- curatedMetagenomicData::sampleMetadata %>%
  filter(body_site == "stool", age_category == "adult", study_condition == "control") %>%
  distinct(study_name, subject_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
meta <- meta %>% slice_sample(n = min(500, nrow(meta)))

# Downloads public reference data
tse <- curatedMetagenomicData::returnSamples(meta, "relative_abundance", rownames = "long")
mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(tse)

# Species-level rows, with genus and species names parsed from the lineage string
tax     <- rownames(mat)
sp_rows <- str_detect(tax, "\\|s__") & !str_detect(tax, "\\|t__")
genus_of   <- str_match(tax[sp_rows], "g__([^|]+)")[, 2]
species_of <- str_match(tax[sp_rows], "s__([^|]+)")[, 2] %>% str_replace_all("_", " ")

# Genus level: sum species within each genus, then prevalence and mean abundance
genus_mat <- rowsum(mat[sp_rows, , drop = FALSE], group = genus_of)
human_genera <- tibble(
  Genus          = rownames(genus_mat),
  prevalence     = rowMeans(genus_mat > 0),
  mean_abundance = rowMeans(genus_mat)
)


```
```{r}
# Gut-associated phyla: detected in >= 1% of healthy adult stool samples
phylum_of <- str_match(tax[sp_rows], "p__([^|]+)")[, 2] %>%
  recode("Bacteroidetes" = "Bacteroidota", "Firmicutes" = "Bacillota",
         "Proteobacteria" = "Pseudomonadota", "Actinobacteria" = "Actinomycetota",
         "Verrucomicrobia" = "Verrucomicrobiota", "Fusobacteria" = "Fusobacteriota")
ph_mat <- rowsum(mat[sp_rows, , drop = FALSE], group = phylum_of)
human_phyla <- tibble(Phylum = rownames(ph_mat),
                      prevalence = rowMeans(ph_mat > 0),
                      mean_abundance = rowMeans(ph_mat)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abundance))
print(as.data.frame(human_phyla))

gut_phyla <- human_phyla %>% filter(prevalence >= 0.01) %>% pull(Phylum)
```


```{r plot-phylum-richness, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
min_genomes        <- 3    # genus needs at least this many genomes
min_dots_phylum    <- 3   # plot only phyla with MORE than this many genera (dots)

genus_summary <- genome_div %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(n_genomes = n(), mean_richness = mean(richness), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(genus_phylum, by = "Genus") %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% gut_phyla, n_genomes >= min_genomes)

# Keep phyla with more than 10 dots
phyla_kept <- genus_summary %>% dplyr::count(Phylum) %>% filter(n > min_dots_phylum) %>% pull(Phylum)
message("Dropped (<= ", min_dots_phylum, " genera): ",
        paste(setdiff(unique(genus_summary$Phylum), phyla_kept), collapse = ", "))
genus_summary <- genus_summary %>% filter(Phylum %in% phyla_kept)

# Order phyla by mean richness, highest first; colours follow that order
phylum_levels <- genus_summary %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>% summarise(m = mean(mean_richness)) %>%
  arrange(desc(m)) %>% pull(Phylum)
phylum_fill   <- setNames(rep_len(pal_fill,   length(phylum_levels)), phylum_levels)
phylum_border <- setNames(rep_len(pal_border, length(phylum_levels)), phylum_levels)
genus_summary <- genus_summary %>% mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum, levels = phylum_levels))
print(genus_summary %>% group_by(Phylum) %>%
        summarise(n_genera = n(), mean_richness = mean(mean_richness)) %>% as.data.frame())

p_phylum_rich <- ggplot(genus_summary,
                        aes(x = Phylum, y = mean_richness, fill = Phylum, colour = Phylum)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_fill) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = phylum_border) +
  labs(title = "CAZyme richness across human gut-associated phyla (each point = one genus)",
       y = "Mean CAZyme families per genome", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
print(p_phylum_rich)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "cazyme_richness_phyla.svg"), p_phylum_rich,
       device = svglite::svglite, width = 9, height = 6, units = "in")
```

```{r phylum-richness-unbiased}


set.seed(1)

prev_cut          <- 0.05   # gut-associated = detected in >= 5% of stool samples
min_genomes_genus <- 1      # primary analysis keeps every genus

# ---- 0. Gut-associated phyla, with names harmonised to NCBI -------------------
hp <- human_phyla %>%
  mutate(Phylum = recode(Phylum, "Tenericutes" = "Mycoplasmatota",
                         "Spirochaetes" = "Spirochaetota")) %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(prevalence = max(prevalence), mean_abundance = sum(mean_abundance),
            .groups = "drop")
gut_set <- hp %>% filter(prevalence >= prevalence_min | prevalence >= prev_cut) %>%
  filter(prevalence >= prev_cut) %>% pull(Phylum)

# ---- 1. Coverage: every gut phylum, whether or not it has CAZy data ------------
gd <- genome_div %>% inner_join(genus_phylum, by = "Genus") %>% filter(Phylum %in% gut_set)

gen <- gd %>% group_by(Phylum, Genus) %>%
  summarise(n_genomes = n(), mean_richness = mean(richness), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_genomes >= min_genomes_genus)

coverage <- hp %>% filter(Phylum %in% gut_set) %>%
  left_join(gen %>% group_by(Phylum) %>%
              summarise(n_genera = n(), n_genomes = sum(n_genomes),
                        mean_genus_richness = mean(mean_richness), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "Phylum") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_genus_richness))
print(as.data.frame(coverage))
message("Gut phyla with no CAZy genera (check name matching): ",
        paste(coverage$Phylum[is.na(coverage$n_genera)], collapse = ", "))

gen <- gen %>% mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum))
gd  <- gd %>% semi_join(gen, by = "Genus") %>% mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum))

# ---- 2. Primary model: all genomes, genus as random effect ----------------------
#      (small genera are shrunk toward their phylum, so sampling effort cannot
#       drive the ranking; no reference phylum is chosen)
m   <- lmer(richness ~ Phylum + (1 | Genus), data = gd)
emm <- emmeans(m, "Phylum")
print(as.data.frame(emm) %>% arrange(desc(emmean)))     # estimated mean richness + 95% CI
print(pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey"))                      # all pairwise, family-wise corrected

# ---- 3. Non-parametric check on genus means, all phyla ------------------------------
print(kruskal.test(mean_richness ~ Phylum, data = gen))
print(pairwise.wilcox.test(gen$mean_richness, gen$Phylum,
                           p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE))

# ---- 4. Which phylum is richest? Bootstrap over genera, every phylum ----------------
n_boot <- 5000
by_phylum  <- split(gen$mean_richness, gen$Phylum)
boot_means <- replicate(n_boot, vapply(by_phylum,
                function(x) mean(x[sample.int(length(x), replace = TRUE)]), numeric(1)))
top_each <- rownames(boot_means)[apply(boot_means, 2, which.max)]
print(tibble(Phylum = top_each) %>% dplyr::count(Phylum, name = "n_top") %>%
        mutate(prop_top = n_top / n_boot) %>% arrange(desc(prop_top)))

# Permutation test: is the highest phylum mean higher than chance, given group sizes?
obs_max  <- max(tapply(gen$mean_richness, gen$Phylum, mean))
perm_max <- replicate(10000, max(tapply(gen$mean_richness, sample(gen$Phylum), mean)))
message("Permutation p for the top phylum mean = ", mean(perm_max >= obs_max))

# ---- 5. Sensitivity: does the top phylum change with the thresholds? -----------------
grid <- expand.grid(prev_cut = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10), min_genomes = c(1, 3, 5))
sens <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
  g  <- grid[i, ]
  gs <- hp %>% filter(prevalence >= g$prev_cut) %>% pull(Phylum)
  s  <- genome_div %>% group_by(Genus) %>%
    summarise(n_genomes = n(), mean_richness = mean(richness), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_genomes >= g$min_genomes) %>%
    inner_join(genus_phylum, by = "Genus") %>% filter(Phylum %in% gs) %>%
    group_by(Phylum) %>%
    summarise(n_genera = n(), m = mean(mean_richness), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_genera >= 2) %>% arrange(desc(m))
  tibble(prev_cut = g$prev_cut, min_genomes = g$min_genomes, n_phyla = nrow(s),
         top = s$Phylum[1], top_mean = s$m[1], second = s$Phylum[2], second_mean = s$m[2])
}) %>% bind_rows()
print(as.data.frame(sens))
```

```{r plot-bacteroides-dotplot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
target_genus   <- "Bacteroides"
top_n_species  <- 15     # species to show (use e.g. 100 to show all)
min_genomes_sp <- 3      # a species needs at least this many genomes for a stable mean richness
exclude_sp     <- TRUE   # drop unresolved "sp." entries

# ---- 1. Mean CAZyme richness per species (from the genomes) -------------------
sp_genomes <- genome_div %>%
  filter(Genus == target_genus) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = str_split_fixed(Genome, "\\|", 3)[, 2],
    Label   = paste(Genus, Species)
  ) %>%
  filter(Species != "", !is.na(Species))

if (exclude_sp) {
  sp_genomes <- sp_genomes %>% filter(!str_detect(Species, "^sp(\\.|$)"))
}

species_rich <- sp_genomes %>%
  group_by(Label) %>%
  summarise(n_genomes = n(), mean_richness = mean(richness), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_genomes >= min_genomes_sp)

# ---- 2. Relative abundance per species (from the stool metagenomes) -----------
# Uses mat, tax and sp_rows from the human-gut-check chunk
species_of <- str_match(tax[sp_rows], "s__([^|]+)")[, 2] %>% str_replace_all("_", " ")
sp_mat     <- rowsum(mat[sp_rows, , drop = FALSE], group = species_of)

human_sp <- tibble(
  Label          = rownames(sp_mat),
  mean_abundance = rowMeans(sp_mat),       # mean over all samples, in %
  prevalence     = rowMeans(sp_mat > 0)    # fraction of samples where detected
)

# ---- 3. Combine, keep species found in the human data, take the top N ---------
message("Not found in the human data: ",
        paste(setdiff(species_rich$Label, human_sp$Label), collapse = ", "))

species_dot <- species_rich %>%
  inner_join(human_sp, by = "Label") %>%
  filter(mean_abundance > 0) %>%                      # zeros cannot go on a log axis
  slice_max(order_by = mean_richness, n = top_n_species, with_ties = FALSE)

print(as.data.frame(species_dot))

# ---- 4. Dot plot: one dot = one species -------------------------------------------
p_dot <- ggplot(species_dot, aes(x = mean_richness, y = mean_abundance, size = prevalence)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = pal_fill[1], colour = pal_border[1], alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = paste(target_genus, "species: CAZyme richness vs. abundance in human stool"),
       x = "Mean distinct CAZyme families per genome",
       y = "Mean relative abundance in stool metagenomes (%, log scale)",
       size = "Prevalence") +
  theme_minimal()

# Species labels (ggrepel if installed, otherwise plain text)
if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_dot <- p_dot + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE)
} else {
  p_dot <- p_dot + geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 3, vjust = -1,
                             check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE)
}

print(p_dot)
write_xlsx(species_dot,
           path = file.path(out_dir, "table_2.xlsx"))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "bacteroides_richness_vs_abundance.svg"),
  plot     = p_dot,
  device   = svglite::svglite,
  width    = 10, height = 7, units = "in"
)
```
